properties.name: management.logging.export.otlp.enabled
properties.description: Whether auto-configuration of logging is enabled to export logs over OTLP.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.enabled
properties.description: Whether OpenTelemetry should be enabled. If OpenTelemetry is disabled, only propagators are configured. Metrics, traces, and logging will use no-op implementations.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.max-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum batch size for each export. This must be less than or equal to 'maxQueueSize'.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.max-queue-size
properties.description: Maximum number of logs that are kept in the queue before they will be dropped.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.otlp.compression
properties.description: Method used to compress the payload.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.otlp.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout for the OTel collector connection.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.otlp.endpoint
properties.description: URL to the OTel collector's HTTP API.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.otlp.headers
properties.description: Custom HTTP headers you want to pass to the collector, for example auth headers.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.otlp.ssl.bundle
properties.description: SSL bundle name.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.otlp.timeout
properties.description: Call timeout for the OTel Collector to process an exported batch of data. This timeout spans the entire call: resolving DNS, connecting, writing the request body, server processing, and reading the response body. If the call requires redirects or retries all must complete within one timeout period.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.otlp.transport
properties.description: Transport used to send the logs.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.schedule-delay
properties.description: The delay interval between two consecutive exports.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.export.timeout
properties.description: Maximum time an export will be allowed to run before being cancelled.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.limits.max-attribute-value-length
properties.description: Maximum number of characters for string attribute values.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.logging.limits.max-attributes
properties.description: Maximum number of attributes per log record.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.map-environment-variables
properties.description: Whether to map OpenTelemetry SDK environment variables to Spring Boot configuration properties.

properties.name: management.opentelemetry.resource-attributes
properties.description: Resource attributes.
